title: Korah
lead: A Levite who led a revolt against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness (Numbers 16). His name stands for rebellion against God's appointed servants; his descendants became temple singers.

sections.b: Korah, with Dathan, Abiram and 250 leaders, accused Moses and Aaron: "Enough of you! The whole community is holy" (Numbers 16:3). Moses left the decision to God. The ground opened and swallowed the rebels' households, and fire consumed the 250 who offered incense.
"The sons of Korah did not die" (Numbers 26:11). Their descendants served as gatekeepers and singers, and eleven psalms carry their name, including Psalms 42, 46 and 84.
